title: The Greek Gift
setup: A French Defense gone quiet: the center is locked, Black has castled, and no black knight can ever reach f6 again. Break open the king's shelter.
hint: The bishop aims at h7, a knight is one hop from g5, and the queen is one move from h5. Count those three, then look at the pawn on e5.
explanation:
## The Idea

The **Greek gift**. The pawn on e5 keeps every black knight off f6, the one condition the sacrifice needs.

{{Bxh7+}} rips the shelter open, and after {{Kxh7}} comes {{Ng5+}}. Black's toughest defense is to give the queen for that knight at once; retreating with {{Kg8}} lets {{Qh5}} set up mate on h7, and then only giving the queen still holds.

Before a Greek gift, check that the bishop reaches h7, a knight reaches g5, the queen reaches h5, and nothing black can reach f6.
